free_tier_limits.correction: Up to 250 active profiles, 500 email sends per month, and 150 mobile messaging credits per month; mobile-credit usage varies by region and carrier.

rate_limits.correction: Published per endpoint, generally using burst/steady tiers: XS 1/s and 15/m; S 3/s and 60/m; M 10/s and 150/m; L 75/s and 700/m; XL 350/s and 3500/m.

notes: The API is active, but the entry incorrectly says rate limits are unpublished and omits known free-plan limits. The example's 2024-10-15 revision remains supported through 2026-10-15, although it is deprecated; new integrations should use the latest stable revision, currently 2026-07-15.
